text_en: I was ready to be sought out by those who did not ask, to be found by those who did not seek me. I said, “Here I am, here I am, ” to a nation that did not call on my name.
text_cn: 从未求问我的，我要让他寻求我；从未寻找我的，我要让他找到我；我对那从未称呼我名的民族说：“看，我在这里！ 我在这里！ ”

text_en: I held out my hands all day long to a rebellious people, who walk in a way that is not good, following their own devices;
text_cn: 我整天向悖(bèi)逆的民族，即随自己的思念走邪辟路的人，伸出我的手。

text_en: a people who provoke me to my face continually, sacrificing in gardens and offering incense on bricks;
text_cn: 这民族时常在我面前惹我发怒，在园中献祭，在砖台上焚香；

text_en: who sit inside tombs, and spend the night in secret places; who eat swine’s flesh, with broth of abominable things in their vessels;
text_cn: 他们住在坟墓内，宿在隐密处，吃猪肉，在他们的器皿中都是些不洁之物，

text_en: who say, “Keep to yourself, do not come near me, for I am too holy for you. ” These are a smoke in my nostrils, a fire that burns all day long.
text_cn: 他们还对人说：“站远点，别靠近我，怕我圣洁了你。”这些事真叫我鼻子冒烟，整日冒火。

text_en: See, it is written before me: I will not keep silent, but I will repay; I will indeed repay into their laps
text_cn: 看哪！ 这一切已在我面前写定；我决不缄默，我非报复不可。

text_en: their iniquities and their ancestors’ iniquities together, says the Lord ; because they offered incense on the mountains and reviled me on the hills, I will measure into their laps full payment for their actions.
text_cn: 我要一起报复他们的罪恶和他们祖先的罪恶：上主说。因为他们在山上烧过香，在丘陵上亵谩过我，所以我要量好他们应得的报应，报应到他们的怀中。

text_en: Thus says the Lord : As the wine is found in the cluster, and they say, “Do not destroy it, for there is a blessing in it, ” so I will do for my servants’ sake, and not destroy them all.
text_cn: 上主这样说：“就如当人发现葡萄内尚有酒汁时，就说：不要破坏它，因为里面还有祝福；我为了我的仆人也要这样作，不将他们完全消灭。

text_en: I will bring forth descendants from Jacob, and from Judah inheritors of my mountains; my chosen shall inherit it, and my servants shall settle there.
text_cn: 我要使雅各伯生出苗裔，使犹大生出继承我山的人；我的选民要以她为业，我的仆人要住在那里。

text_en: Sharon shall become a pasture for flocks, and the Valley of Achor a place for herds to lie down, for my people who have sought me.
text_cn: 为那寻求我的百姓，沙龙将成为羊群的牧场，阿苛尔山谷为那寻求我的百姓，要成为牛群的栖所。”

text_en: But you who forsake the Lord , who forget my holy mountain, who set a table for Fortune and fill cups of mixed wine for Destiny;
text_cn: “至于你们这些离弃上主，忘记我的圣山，为加得神设宴，给默尼神注满调和的酒的人，

text_en: I will destine you to the sword, and all of you shall bow down to the slaughter; because, when I called, you did not answer, when I spoke, you did not listen, but you did what was evil in my sight, and chose what I did not delight in.
text_cn: 我注定了你们归于刀下，你们要屈身受戮；因为我喊叫你们，你们没有回答；我说话，你们不肯听，反而去行我视为恶的事，拣选我所不喜欢的事。”

text_en: Therefore thus says the Lord God : My servants shall eat, but you shall be hungry; my servants shall drink, but you shall be thirsty; my servants shall rejoice, but you shall be put to shame;
text_cn: 因此吾主上主这样说：“你们要看见我的仆人有得吃，你们却要饥饿；你们看见我的仆人有得喝，你们却要口渴；你们看见我的仆人喜乐，你们却要哭泣；

text_en: my servants shall sing for gladness of heart, but you shall cry out for pain of heart, and shall wail for anguish of spirit.
text_cn: 你们看见我的仆人因心中快乐而欢庆，你们却要因心中忧苦而悲号，因丧气而哀伤。

text_en: You shall leave your name to my chosen to use as a curse, and the Lord God will put you to death; but to his servants he will give a different name.
text_cn: 你们将留下你们的名给我的选民作咒词：‘吾主上主将如此叫你死！’但是我的仆人要有另一个名字作称呼。”

text_en: Then whoever invokes a blessing in the land shall bless by the God of faithfulness, and whoever takes an oath in the land shall swear by the God of faithfulness; because the former troubles are forgotten and are hidden from my sight.
text_cn: 所以那在地上为自己求福的，要向真实的天主求福；那在地上起誓的，要指着真实的天主起誓，因为先前的苦难都已忘记，从我的眼前隐匿了。

text_en: For I am about to create new heavens and a new earth; the former things shall not be remembered or come to mind.
text_cn: 因为，看，我要创造新天新地，先前的不再被记忆，不再被关心。

text_en: But be glad and rejoice forever in what I am creating; for I am about to create Jerusalem as a joy, and its people as a delight.
text_cn: 人们都要因我所造的而永远喜悦快乐；因为，看，我要造一座令人喜悦的耶路撒冷，一个令人欢乐的百姓。

text_en: I will rejoice in Jerusalem, and delight in my people; no more shall the sound of weeping be heard in it, or the cry of distress.
text_cn: 我要因耶路撒冷而喜悦，因我的百姓而欢欣，其中再听不到哭泣和哀号的声音。

text_en: No more shall there be in it an infant that lives but a few days, or an old person who does not live out a lifetime; for one who dies at a hundred years will be considered a youth, and one who falls short of a hundred will be considered accursed.
text_cn: 那里再没有夭折的婴儿和不满寿数的老人；百岁死去的人算是青年，凡活不到百岁的人算是被诅咒的。

text_en: They shall build houses and inhabit them; they shall plant vineyards and eat their fruit.
text_cn: 他们要建筑房舍，自居其中；种植葡萄，自食其果；

text_en: They shall not build and another inhabit; they shall not plant and another eat; for like the days of a tree shall the days of my people be, and my chosen shall long enjoy the work of their hands.
text_cn: 并不是他们建筑而别人来住，他们种植而别人来吃，因为我百姓的寿数有如树木的年数，我的选民要享用她自己的劳作。

text_en: They shall not labor in vain, or bear children for calamity; for they shall be offspring blessed by the Lord — and their descendants as well.
text_cn: 他们不再徒然勤劳，生子不再受惊，因为他们是上主祝福的苗裔，他们的子孙亦将如此。

text_en: Before they call I will answer, while they are yet speaking I will hear.
text_cn: 那时，他们还未呼求，我已答应了；他们还在祈祷，我已俯允了。

text_en: The wolf and the lamb shall feed together, the lion shall eat straw like the ox; but the serpent—its food shall be dust! They shall not hurt or destroy on all my holy mountain, says the Lord .
text_cn: 豺狼和羔羊将要一齐牧放，狮子要如牛犊一般吃草，尘土将是大蛇的食物；在我的整个圣山上，再没有谁作恶，也没有谁害人：上主说。
